meaning.en: Persuasive enough that people accept it without doubt.
meaning.zh: 有说服力，让人心服口服。

examples.zh: 他的论证严密，令人信服。
examples.en: His argument is tightly reasoned and utterly convincing.

examples.zh: 专家给出的数据令人信服。
examples.en: The data the expert presented is convincing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (令人信服的证据). Pairs with 解释, 理由, 论据.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，常与“解释、理由、证据”搭配。

meaning.en: So sad or poignant that it makes people sigh with regret.
meaning.zh: 让人感慨叹息，替人惋惜。

examples.zh: 曾经的明星如今无人问津，令人唏嘘。
examples.en: The once-famous star is now forgotten, which makes one sigh.

examples.zh: 这个故事的结局令人唏嘘。
examples.en: The ending of the story is poignant and sad.

usage.en: Predicate; common in news and commentary about sad turns of fate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于新闻和评论，指命运无常令人感叹。

meaning.en: A person of clean conduct will be seen to be clean without arguing the case.
meaning.zh: 品行清白的人，自然不怕别人的诽谤和猜疑。

equivalents: the innocent have nothing to fear

examples.zh: 清者自清，你不必理会那些谣言。
examples.en: The innocent need no defence, so just ignore the rumours.

examples.zh: 他相信清者自清，没有出面解释。
examples.en: He believed his innocence would speak for itself and did not explain.

usage.en: Used as a standalone remark, often with 浊者自浊. Comforting rather than legal.
usage.zh: 常单独成句，常与“浊者自浊”连用，多用于自我宽慰或安慰他人。

meaning.en: Things have already reached this point, so it cannot be undone.
meaning.zh: 事情已经发展到这个地步，无法挽回。

equivalents: now that things are like this

examples.zh: 事已至此，后悔也没用了。
examples.en: It has come to this; regret is useless now.

examples.zh: 事已至此，我们只能想办法补救。
examples.en: Now that things have reached this point, all we can do is try to put them right.

usage.en: Opens a sentence, followed by a resigned or practical remark.
usage.zh: 多用于句首，后接无奈或务实的话。

meaning.en: Having reached middle age, with its burdens and its perspective.
meaning.zh: 人的年龄到了四五十岁的阶段。

examples.zh: 人到中年，上有老下有小，压力很大。
examples.en: In midlife, with parents and children to look after, the pressure is great.

examples.zh: 人到中年，他才懂得健康的可贵。
examples.en: Only in middle age did he learn how precious health is.

usage.en: Starts a clause about the pressures or reflections of midlife.
usage.zh: 常作分句开头，后面说中年的压力或感悟。

natural: with the main points clearly highlighted

meaning.en: Written or arranged so that the main points stand out clearly.
meaning.zh: 主要内容明确醒目，一看就懂。

examples.zh: 这份报告重点突出，条理清楚。
examples.en: The report is focused and clearly organised.

examples.zh: 发言要重点突出，不要面面俱到。
examples.en: A speech should highlight its key points rather than cover everything.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; commonly used to praise reports, plans and essays.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或补语，常用来评价报告、计划和文章。

meaning.en: Having won great distinction through military achievements.
meaning.zh: 在战争中立下了显赫的功劳。

examples.zh: 这位将军战功赫赫，深受士兵爱戴。
examples.en: The general has a distinguished war record and is much loved by his soldiers.

examples.zh: 他是一位战功赫赫的老兵。
examples.en: He is a veteran with a glorious combat record.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (战功赫赫的将领).
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Not intimidated by those with power; standing up to authority.
meaning.zh: 不害怕有权有势的人，敢于坚持正义。

examples.zh: 她不畏强权，坚持说出真相。
examples.en: Unafraid of the powerful, she insisted on telling the truth.

examples.zh: 历史上有许多不畏强权的人。
examples.en: History has many people who stood up to tyranny.

usage.en: Verb phrase or attributive; praises moral courage.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，称赞勇于抗争的品格。

meaning.en: With eyes full of tears, on the verge of weeping.
meaning.zh: 眼里含满泪水，快要哭出来的样子。

examples.zh: 小女孩眼泪汪汪地看着妈妈。
examples.en: The little girl looked at her mother, eyes brimming with tears.

examples.zh: 他被批评后眼泪汪汪，什么也没说。
examples.en: After being scolded he stood teary-eyed and said nothing.

usage.en: Usually an adverbial before a verb, with 地; or a predicate.
usage.zh: 常在动词前作状语（眼泪汪汪地），也可作谓语。

meaning.en: To bully and lord it over the people of one's home area.
meaning.zh: 在家乡一带仗势欺人，为非作歹。

examples.zh: 他仗着有钱有势，横行乡里多年。
examples.en: Relying on wealth and influence, he terrorised the area for years.

examples.zh: 横行乡里的恶霸终于被抓了。
examples.en: The local tyrant who ran rampant has finally been arrested.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical of crime and historical writing.
usage.zh: 可作谓语或定语，多见于社会新闻和历史叙述。

meaning.en: To look up at the sky and sigh long, in sorrow or helplessness.
meaning.zh: 抬头望天，发出长长的叹息，形容悲伤或无奈。

equivalents: heave a long sigh to the heavens

examples.zh: 面对这样的结果，他只能仰天长叹。
examples.en: Faced with this outcome, all he could do was sigh at the sky.

examples.zh: 老人望着干裂的田地，仰天长叹。
examples.en: The old man looked at the cracked fields and sighed heavily to the heavens.

usage.en: Predicate; a dramatic, bookish gesture, sometimes used jokingly.
usage.zh: 作谓语，带戏剧色彩，有时也用于调侃。

meaning.en: To celebrate a victory or a great success loudly.
meaning.zh: 高声唱着胜利之歌，比喻取得胜利后欢庆。

examples.zh: 球队高唱凯歌，捧回了冠军奖杯。
examples.en: The team sang songs of triumph and brought home the trophy.

examples.zh: 大军高唱凯歌，班师回朝。
examples.en: The army returned home singing songs of victory.

usage.en: Predicate; literal or figurative; often followed by 而归 or 前进.
usage.zh: 作谓语，可指真唱凯歌，也可比喻取得胜利。

natural: as a small token of one's feelings

meaning.en: To show one's goodwill or gratitude with a modest gift or gesture.
meaning.zh: 用一点小礼物或小行动表达自己的心意。

examples.zh: 这点小礼物，聊表心意，请收下。
examples.en: This small gift is a token of my feelings; please accept it.

examples.zh: 我们送上鲜花，聊表心意。
examples.en: We are sending flowers as a small gesture of goodwill.

usage.en: Polite and modest; typical with gifts, donations and condolences.
usage.zh: 谦辞，多用于送礼、捐款、慰问等场合。

natural: the better is obvious at once

meaning.en: The difference in quality is so clear that the winner is obvious immediately.
meaning.zh: 两者一比较，谁好谁差马上就能看出来。

equivalents: the gap is plain at a glance

examples.zh: 两款手机放在一起，高下立判。
examples.en: Put the two phones side by side and the difference is obvious.

examples.zh: 一交手，两人的水平高下立判。
examples.en: As soon as they crossed swords, it was clear who was better.

usage.en: Predicate, often after 一比 / 一对比 / 放在一起.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常用在“一比较、一对比”之后。

natural: seeing red; burning with envy or hatred

meaning.en: Extremely angry or envious when seeing a rival or an enemy.
meaning.zh: 仇人或对手相见时特别愤恨，也指特别嫉妒。

examples.zh: 仇人相见，分外眼红。
examples.en: When enemies meet, they see red.

examples.zh: 看到别人升职，他分外眼红。
examples.en: Seeing others promoted, he was green with envy.

usage.en: Idiom-like set phrase; the saying 仇人相见，分外眼红 is common.
usage.zh: 常见于俗语“仇人相见，分外眼红”。

meaning.en: Friends of long standing meeting again after a separation.
meaning.zh: 多年的老朋友分别后再次相见。

examples.zh: 老友重逢，大家聊了整整一夜。
examples.en: The old friends were reunited and talked all night.

examples.zh: 老友重逢，格外亲切。
examples.en: Meeting an old friend again feels especially warm.

usage.en: Often a heading or opening phrase; a warm, happy tone.
usage.zh: 常作标题或句首，语气亲切愉快。

meaning.en: Two armies drawn up face to face, ready to fight; also two rivals in a showdown.
meaning.zh: 两支军队相对布阵，互相对峙；也比喻双方对抗。

examples.zh: 两军对垒，战场上一片肃杀。
examples.en: With two armies facing each other, a deathly stillness hung over the battlefield.

examples.zh: 比赛如同两军对垒，气氛十分紧张。
examples.en: The match was like two armies facing off, and the atmosphere was tense.

usage.en: Predicate or set opening; often used figuratively for sport and business.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或句首，常比喻体育、商业等的对抗。

meaning.en: So irritating or tactless that people dislike one.
meaning.zh: 言行让人觉得烦、不喜欢。

examples.zh: 他总爱打断别人，真惹人讨厌。
examples.en: He keeps interrupting people, which is really annoying.

examples.zh: 这种惹人讨厌的习惯要改一改。
examples.en: You should break that irritating habit.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; casual, spoken.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，口语色彩较强。

literal: cause · people · give rise to · disgust

meaning.en: Making people feel disgusted or tired of it.
meaning.zh: 让人感到厌烦、讨厌。

examples.zh: 他那副自以为是的样子令人生厌。
examples.en: His know-it-all manner is off-putting.

examples.zh: 重复的广告令人生厌。
examples.en: The repeated adverts are tiresome.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a little more formal than 惹人讨厌.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，比“惹人讨厌”稍书面。

meaning.en: To seize public money for one's own use.
meaning.zh: 把公家的钱财据为己有。

examples.zh: 他因侵吞公款被判了十年。
examples.en: He was sentenced to ten years for embezzling public funds.

examples.zh: 侵吞公款的官员受到了严惩。
examples.en: The official who embezzled public funds was severely punished.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; typical of news and legal reports.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常见于新闻和法律报道。

meaning.en: To take public money temporarily or illegally for another use, usually one's own.
meaning.zh: 擅自把公家的钱用于别的用途。

examples.zh: 会计挪用公款炒股，被公司报了警。
examples.en: The accountant diverted public funds into the stock market, and the firm called the police.

examples.zh: 挪用公款是违法行为。
examples.en: Misusing public funds is a crime.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; milder than 侵吞 as it may be 'borrowing' in intent.
usage.zh: 动宾短语；与“侵吞”相比，强调擅自改变用途。

meaning.en: With one's whole face red from shame, anger, drink or effort.
meaning.zh: 整张脸都红了，多因害羞、生气、喝酒或用力。

examples.zh: 被老师点名表扬，他满脸通红。
examples.en: Praised by name by the teacher, he went red in the face.

examples.zh: 他喝了两杯就满脸通红。
examples.en: Two drinks and his face was flushed.

usage.en: Predicate; also adverbial with 地.
usage.zh: 作谓语，也可作状语（满脸通红地）。

meaning.en: To bring glory and prestige to one's family through one's own success.
meaning.zh: 靠自己的成就使家族更有名望、更显赫。

equivalents: bring honour to the family name

examples.zh: 他立志成才，光大门楣。
examples.en: He resolved to make something of himself and bring honour to his family.

examples.zh: 长辈都盼着他光大门楣。
examples.en: His elders hoped he would raise the family's standing.

usage.en: Verb phrase; somewhat traditional or formal in tone.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，带传统、庄重色彩。

meaning.en: Not holding past grievances against someone.
meaning.zh: 不把过去的怨恨放在心上。

examples.zh: 两位老同事不计前嫌，重新合作。
examples.en: The two old colleagues buried the hatchet and began working together again.

examples.zh: 他不计前嫌，帮了对手一把。
examples.en: He let bygones be bygones and helped his rival.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 握手言和 or 重归于好.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常与“握手言和、重归于好”连用。

natural: setting off late yet arriving first

meaning.en: To start later than others but still get there first.
meaning.zh: 比别人出发得晚，却先到达，比喻后来居上。

examples.zh: 他起步虽晚，却后发先至，拿了冠军。
examples.en: He started late yet overtook everyone and took the title.

examples.zh: 这家公司凭技术后发先至。
examples.en: Through technology the company overtook its earlier rivals.

usage.en: Used in sport, business and technology; positive.
usage.zh: 多用于体育、商业、科技，含褒义。

natural: away from the hustle and bustle

meaning.en: To stay away from the noise and bustle of the busy world.
meaning.zh: 远远离开喧闹的世俗和都市生活。

examples.zh: 我们想找个远离尘嚣的小村子住几天。
examples.en: We'd like to stay a few days in a little village far from the bustle.

examples.zh: 远离尘嚣，他在山中过着平静的日子。
examples.en: Away from the hurly-burly, he lives peacefully in the mountains.

usage.en: Often an adjective phrase for places (远离尘嚣的地方).
usage.zh: 常作定语修饰地点（远离尘嚣的小岛）。

meaning.en: To refuse to tolerate wrongdoing or let offenders off lightly.
meaning.zh: 对错误或违法行为绝不放纵、不宽容。

examples.zh: 对酒后驾车的行为，我们绝不姑息。
examples.en: We show no leniency towards drink-driving.

examples.zh: 学校对欺凌现象绝不姑息。
examples.en: The school has zero tolerance for bullying.

usage.en: Predicate; typical of official statements and warnings.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常见于官方声明和警告。

natural: please take good care of yourself

meaning.en: A polite farewell wishing someone good health and safety.
meaning.zh: 分别时请对方多注意身体和安全的客气话。

examples.zh: 天气冷了，请多保重。
examples.en: It's getting cold; please take care of yourself.

examples.zh: 你一路辛苦，请多保重。
examples.en: It's been a long journey; please look after yourself.

usage.en: Set farewell, in speech or at the end of letters.
usage.zh: 告别或书信结尾的客套话。

meaning.en: The classic look of Jiangnan houses: white-washed walls under grey-black roof tiles.
meaning.zh: 指江南传统民居白色的墙壁和青黑色的瓦顶。

examples.zh: 江南水乡，白墙黛瓦，美如画卷。
examples.en: In the water towns of Jiangnan, white walls and dark tiles make a picture.

examples.zh: 村子里一排排白墙黛瓦的老房子很有韵味。
examples.en: The rows of old white-walled, grey-tiled houses in the village have real charm.

usage.en: Scenery description; often linked with 小桥流水.
usage.zh: 描写景色，常与“小桥流水”连用。

meaning.en: Clear, firm and unwavering, with no vagueness or slackness.
meaning.zh: 态度明确、做事认真，一点也不马虎。

examples.zh: 他对原则问题毫不含糊。
examples.en: He is unequivocal on matters of principle.

examples.zh: 在训练中，教练要求毫不含糊。
examples.en: In training, the coach tolerates no sloppiness.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often 对…毫不含糊.
usage.zh: 作谓语或补语，常说“对……毫不含糊”。

meaning.en: Behaving in a poised, proper and dignified way.
meaning.zh: 言行姿态端正稳重，有礼貌。

examples.zh: 她举止端庄，给面试官留下好印象。
examples.en: She carried herself with dignity and impressed the interviewers.

examples.zh: 礼仪课教我们举止端庄大方。
examples.en: The etiquette class taught us to behave with dignity and grace.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; commonly said of women or in etiquette contexts.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多形容人的仪态，也用于礼仪教育。

meaning.en: To apologise sincerely and formally.
meaning.zh: 诚恳而郑重地表示道歉。

examples.zh: 因航班延误，我们深表歉意。
examples.en: We sincerely apologise for the flight delay.

examples.zh: 公司对此次事故深表歉意。
examples.en: The company deeply regrets the accident.

usage.en: Verb phrase in notices, announcements and letters.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，用于通知、声明、信函。

meaning.en: A wish for a happy, healthy and peaceful life.
meaning.zh: 祝愿生活幸福，身体健康平安。

equivalents: wishing you happiness and good health

examples.zh: 祝您全家幸福安康！
examples.en: Wishing your whole family happiness and good health!

examples.zh: 愿大家新的一年幸福安康。
examples.en: May everyone have a happy, healthy new year.

usage.en: Mostly in greetings and blessings; also a predicate: 生活幸福安康.
usage.zh: 多用于祝福语，也可作谓语。

meaning.en: A decisive point when the outcome is at stake.
meaning.zh: 事情成败或关系重大的时候。

examples.zh: 关键时刻，他挺身而出。
examples.en: At the critical moment, he stepped forward.

examples.zh: 每个人都想在关键时刻发挥作用。
examples.en: Everyone wants to make a difference when it counts.

usage.en: Common adverbial at the start of a clause (在关键时刻 / 关键时刻，…).
usage.zh: 常作时间状语（在关键时刻、关键时刻，……）。

meaning.en: The reawakening of nature in spring.
meaning.zh: 春天来临，各种生物重新有了生机。

examples.zh: 春天来了，万物复苏。
examples.en: Spring has come and everything is waking up.

examples.zh: 春雨过后，大地万物复苏。
examples.en: After the spring rain, the land came back to life.

usage.en: Predicate; most often about spring and the thaw.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多用来写春天。

meaning.en: Known to people both near and far.
meaning.zh: 远处和近处的人都知道，很有名。

examples.zh: 这家老字号的包子远近闻名。
examples.en: This old brand's steamed buns are famous far and wide.

examples.zh: 他是村里远近闻名的好医生。
examples.en: He is a doctor known for miles around.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (远近闻名的…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语。

synonyms: 门缝里吹喇叭——名（鸣）声在外

meaning.en: Neighbours living together in harmony.
meaning.zh: 邻居之间相处融洽，没有矛盾。

examples.zh: 这个小区邻里和睦，大家常互相帮忙。
examples.en: Neighbours here get along well and often help each other.

examples.zh: 邻里和睦是社区建设的目标。
examples.en: Neighbourly harmony is a goal of community building.

usage.en: Predicate; common in community news and slogans.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常见于社区宣传和口号。

meaning.en: Spirits and fighting will are down in a team or army.
meaning.zh: 队伍或团体的斗志和信心下降。

examples.zh: 连输几场后，球队士气低落。
examples.en: After several defeats in a row, the team's morale was low.

examples.zh: 裁员消息让员工士气低落。
examples.en: News of layoffs left staff demoralised.

usage.en: Predicate; applies to armies, teams and workplaces.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于军队、球队、公司等集体。

meaning.en: Having accomplishments that stand above those of every age.
meaning.zh: 功绩之大，超过千秋万代。

examples.zh: 他治水有功，功盖千秋。
examples.en: His flood control work earned him lasting fame.

examples.zh: 这位帝王自称功盖千秋。
examples.en: The emperor claimed that his deeds would outshine the ages.

usage.en: Praise for a great figure; solemn, sometimes ironic.
usage.zh: 颂扬伟人，语气庄重，有时含讽刺。

meaning.en: Having a style that clearly sets it apart.
meaning.zh: 有与众不同的特色和格调。

examples.zh: 这位设计师的作品风格独特。
examples.en: The designer's works have a distinctive style.

examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆风格独特，很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.en: The cafe has a unique look and is popular with young people.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (风格独特的建筑).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常评价艺术、建筑、店铺。

meaning.en: Symbolising good luck.
meaning.zh: 所象征的意思吉利美好。

examples.zh: 红灯笼寓意吉祥，春节家家都挂。
examples.en: Red lanterns signify good luck, and every home hangs them at the New Year.

examples.zh: 这对玉佩寓意吉祥，适合送人。
examples.en: The jade pendants carry an auspicious meaning and make a good gift.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical of descriptions of gifts, symbols and names.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常用于描述礼物、图案、名字。

meaning.en: Trade that is thriving with plenty of customers.
meaning.zh: 买卖兴旺，顾客很多。

examples.zh: 新店开业后生意红火。
examples.en: After the new shop opened, business boomed.

examples.zh: 祝您生意红火，财源广进！
examples.en: May your business boom and money roll in!

usage.en: Predicate; also a common blessing for shops.
usage.zh: 作谓语，也是开业祝福语。
